beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Just one more video, then I'll sleep.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: It's 3 AM. You said that at midnight.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Okay, okay. Fix my sleep, genius.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip one: wake up at the same time every day.
beats.title: 1. Same wake-up time

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Yes, even on weekends. Your body loves a schedule.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip two: screens off an hour before bed.
beats.title: 2. Screens off early

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Your brain can't relax while it's still scrolling.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: So I just stare at the ceiling?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Read a book. Like a cozy little grandpa.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip three: keep your room cool and dark.
beats.title: 3. Cool + dark room

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: I slept eight hours. I feel... brand new!

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Told you. Sleep is free energy.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Save this, and go to sleep.
